usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all snapshots for a QEMU VM on a remote PVE node managed by PDM, including the live 'current' pseudo-entry that represents the running state. The optional 'node' query parameter narrows the request to a specific node in a clustered remote; omit it to let PDM resolve the VM's host automatically. Requires Resource.Audit on the remote/guest path — read-only and safe to call at any time regardless of VM power state.

examples.summary: List all snapshots for VM 101 on the remote named 'pve-hetzner'

tips: The response always includes a 'current' entry (name: 'current') that represents the live VM state — filter it out if you only need historical snapshots.
The 'snaptime' field is a Unix timestamp; convert to a human-readable date when displaying snapshot age.
The 'vmstate' field indicates whether RAM was included in the snapshot — RAM snapshots are larger and take longer to restore.
If the remote has multiple nodes, specifying 'node' avoids an extra lookup and can reduce latency.
The 'parent' field lets you reconstruct the snapshot tree/chain — useful before deciding which snapshot to roll back to.
